A letter from my heart

"My dearest Mu, this is your first birthday after our marriage, and the first of a lifetime I get to celebrate by your side."

You came into my life and made ordinary days feel special. In such a short time, we met, chose each other, promised forever, and became husband and wife. Yet loving you already feels like the most natural thing I have ever done.

I promise to stand beside you through every season — to celebrate your joy, hold you through every challenge, protect our peace, and keep choosing us. Wherever life takes us, I will travel with you for a lifetime, hand in hand, heart beside heart.

May your twenty-third year bring you the happiness you bring into my world. Happy birthday, my wife, my best friend, my Mu. You are my today and every tomorrow I dream of.

Forever yours,
Raja Abimanyu
